plugins.name: lwr
plugins.description: A token-policy layer that makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical. Ships one walking-skeleton rule, budget_line, gating subagent dispatch on a stated token budget. Policy is per-rule off/warn/deny and fails open. See plugins/claude/lwr/.claude-plugin/plugin.json for the full description.
